summary: Frontend-only visual redesign verification of CelebrationOverlay. Logged in as Office Admin (blr1@finflow.com), navigated to CRM → All leads, exercised Create/Update/Error flows and validated the redesigned overlay: data-testids present, friendly titles, subtitles, gradient hero + frosted GlassFolder + white check/X badge, auto-dismiss, non-blocking backdrop, and no sonner toast duplication. All four scenarios (Success/Added, Auto-dismiss, Update, Error) passed. Test lead cleaned up.

critical_code_review_comments: SUCCESS_SUBTITLE map lacks a default 'Saved' entry override — 'Saved successfully!' resolves to the same subtitle as Updated ('Your changes have been saved.'), which is intentional and fine.

Backdrop uses onClick to dismiss but backdrop has pointer-events:none per computed style; verify the dismiss-on-click is not required by product (it likely relies on the auto-dismiss timer, which works correctly).
